reviews.concise_rationale: The crop is coherent and readable: it shows the TissueCraftAI input path from conditioning image and text prompt through ControlNet/Text Encoder, then cross-attention and VAE decoder to outputs. It visibly supports both listed inference routes.

The crop cleanly captures the cell-to-text generation pathway with scLLM feeding a Q-former projector into the Text LLM, with cell features explicitly labeled. That is sufficient for the listed route.
